info.about: James Bond 007: Blood Stone is a 2010 third-person shooter video game developed by Bizarre Creations and published by Activision for Microsoft Windows, Nintendo DS, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It is the 24th game in the James Bond series and is the first game since James Bond 007: Everything or Nothing to have an original story, set between Quantum of Solace (2008) and Skyfall (2012).
info.trivia: A sequel by Raven Software was reportedly planned but never made, most likely because Blood Stone sold poorly.
info.why: It was Bizarre Creations' final game before the studio closed in February 2011, and it was delisted digitally in 2013 with Activision's other Bond games.
